lead.text: Evidence of record for the thirteen "Matrix by subsystem" rows, one row per pinned case: each row names the subsystem, the half of its cell the case answers, the tier whose own report vouches for the case, and the case by file and verbatim title, with its bound describe path or its it.each minimum where one is bound. test/workbench-subsystem-matrix.census.ts judges the default-gate rows in the report of the default gate and checks the rows of the other tiers at tier level only; no row of this table is read as a live, native or scale pass, and a half no landed case binds is listed as unpinned with its open beads and is never counted as passed. The census judges this table against its own pins in both directions and in table order, so a pin dropped from the census, together with every census literal edited to match, still reads red against this table.
